fields.summary_ko.0: ExxonMobil (XOM) closed at record high of $183.21 on October 23 (+2.79%), up 52% in 2026, and currently exceeds Wall Street average target of $179.41.
fields.summary_ko.1: Achieved double the anticipated $2B annual synergies from Pioneer acquisition, Q2 Permian output set record of more than 1.8M barrels per day, and doubling recovery rate is management's explicit target.
fields.summary_ko.2: ExxonMobil maintains premium at NTM EV/EBITDA of approximately 7x versus 5x for TotalEnergies and Eni, and net margin is expected to expand from 9.1% to 12.6% through 2029.
